title: Sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='62' width='90' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='5' y='62' width='90' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b07a45'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='54' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <!-- body hanging -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='52' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#a8835a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='50' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#c6a37a'/>
  <!-- legs over branch -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='64' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#a8835a'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='64' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#a8835a'/>
  <path d='M42 70 q4 8 6 10' stroke='#c6a37a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 70 q-4 8 -6 10' stroke='#c6a37a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#a8835a'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='37' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#c6a37a'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='41' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#e8d6b8'/>
  <!-- eyes patches -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='35' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#5a3d22'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='35' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#5a3d22'/>
  <!-- eyes glow -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='35' r='1.6' fill='#3ff0c0'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='35' r='1.6' fill='#3ff0c0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='2.2' ry='1.6' fill='#5a3d22'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M36 45 q4 3 8 0' stroke='#5a3d22' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claws -->
  <path d='M14 62 q1 5 2 6' stroke='#e8d6b8' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 62 q1 5 2 6' stroke='#e8d6b8' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 62 q1 5 2 6' stroke='#e8d6b8' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
